title: No heat — profanity, three kids
text: Hi. I'm calling about the heat again. This is the fourth fucking time I've called! We've had no heat at 1820 Walton Avenue, apartment 2C, since Wednesday. I have three kids freezing in here, so get your lazy asses moving!

title: Pothole — insults aimed at the agent
text: Are you people stupid or something? There's a pothole on Linden Boulevard near Euclid Avenue, it blew out my tire yesterday. Write it down, genius, or is that too hard for you? I want someone to call me back.

title: Noise complaint — sexual harassment of the agent
text: Hey sweetheart, you sound cute. What are you wearing right now? Anyway, my upstairs neighbor in apartment 9C at 75 Hart Street plays drums every night after midnight.

title: Threat — escalates to supervisor
text: I've called six times about the parked truck on my hydrant on Court Street! I know where your office is. If nobody tows it today I'm going to come down there and beat the crap out of somebody.

title: Frustrated but civil — passes through untouched
text: I'm really frustrated, this is the third time I'm calling. Water is still leaking through my bathroom ceiling at 222 East 21st Street, apartment 4B. My reference number is 311-20871455. Could you send an inspector this week?

title: Identity attack + open hydrant
text: Put someone on who speaks real English. A hydrant is open on Kingston Avenue at Eastern Parkway and the street is flooding. You people are useless.
